description: v6.8.15 / v6.8.16 closure: Clarify routing gate wired in v6.8.16 after the v6.8.16 prefix-aware procedure scoring lifted strong matches above the threshold.  «нұсқаулық рәсімі қандай?» is intentionally an under-specified procedure shape — single «нұсқаулық» root matches multiple procedure titles weakly (raw=3 in each).  Best score 3 / NORMALISE_CEILING 8 = 0.375 < CLARIFY_THRESHOLD 0.5, so the cascade Clarifies rather than picking a confidently-wrong specific procedure.

v6.8.17 Codex Q3 school bug #1 fix.  «Сәлем, мен 8-сынып оқушысымын.» previously fell into math_solver (because of the «8» numeral) and got the «жазсаңыз — есептеп беремін» refusal template.  recognize_grade_statement now fires BEFORE math, emits a friendly grade-aware greeting.

v6.8.17 regression coverage — bare numeric math («8+5 қанша?») must STILL route to math_solver after the grade-statement detector is added.  The detector is gated on a first-person marker AND a grade-role marker, so this pure-math input falls through.

v6.8.18 Codex Q3 school #5 part 1.  After a biographical intro, the bare «Қай жылы туған?» follow-up resolves the «when was [he] born?» question via the prior-turn Person referent.  Previously fell to a generic «Жыл бір күннен …» definition.

v6.8.19 Codex Q3 school #5b: biographical topics like «Ахмет Байтұрсынұлы» whose world_core domain is `kru_*` are now classified as Person referents (previously fell into Generic because canonical_person_entity covers first-names only).  Verifies the kind via referent_present + Person assertion is implicit in the follow-up resolving correctly.

v6.8.20 Codex Q3 school #2: predicate ellipsis-inherit.  Pre-fix: «Ал көмірқышқыл газының ше?» after a formula query emitted «Оксид» (broad-topic IsA misroute).  v6.8.20 expand_predicate_ellipsis rewrites to «көмірқышқыл газының формуласы» using session.last_query_predicate=formula, so the formula handler fires.
v6.8.20: predicate-ellipsis chain — multiple successive ellipsis follow-ups inherit the formula predicate as long as it's the most-recent typed query.

v6.8.21 Codex Q3 school #3.  Explicit-subject historical alias query: «Астана бұрын қалай аталды?» returns the full alias chain (Ақмолинск → Целиноград → Ақмола → Астана → Нұр-Сұлтан → Астана) from the curated HISTORICAL_ALIASES table.  Previously fell to live-data refusal.

v6.8.21: anaphora variant — biographical intro followed by pronoun-elided historical alias query.  «Алматы туралы айтшы.» → bio.  «Ол бұрын қалай аталды?» → alias chain (Верный → Алма-Ата → Алматы) via the prior-turn Place referent.
